Class WindowsLogicalVolumeGroup

java.lang.Object
oshi.hardware.common.AbstractLogicalVolumeGroup
oshi.hardware.common.platform.windows.WindowsLogicalVolumeGroup
All Implemented Interfaces:
LogicalVolumeGroup
public class WindowsLogicalVolumeGroup extends AbstractLogicalVolumeGroup
Windows implementation of LogicalVolumeGroup, mapping Storage Spaces storage pools to volume groups. Storage Spaces requires Windows 8 or Server 2012.

The correlation logic lives here rather than in the bindings because the MSFT_Storage queries return backend-neutral WmiResult values; only the COM plumbing that runs them differs between the bindings.
